items.subject: Direct-loop control and arithmetic
items.objective: Explore direct-loop control and arithmetic changes with one target per thread, no shared-memory tiling, and no multi-target coarsening. Contrast the original self-exclusion check with split source ranges that exclude j=i without evaluating that interaction; do not simply include the self term, since intermediate overflow could make a zero-displacement term non-finite for extreme mass. Separately test arithmetic variants such as target-mass cancellation or reciprocal-square-root-based factors, first in isolation and then in useful combinations. Validate against the GPU tolerance and FP64 checks, including coincident positions and extreme mass, before timing all scored sizes under the official protocol.
